children: RNS Number : 1379T  Greencoat UK Wind PLC  02 September 2026
Greencoat UK Wind PLC (the "Company") will be hosting a Capital Markets Event at 1.30pm on Thursday 15 October 2026.

Building on the themes presented in the Company's Half Year Results, the event will provide further insight into the Company's approach to delivering attractive shareholder returns in an evolving market. The programme, which will be circulated in advance, will include management presentations, panel discussions and Q&A.

The event will be hosted at The Ned London, 27 Poultry, London, EC2R 8AJ. An informal lunch will be held from 12.30pm. Presentations are expected to conclude by 4.00pm and will be followed by refreshments.
Institutional investors and sell-side analysts wishing to attend in person should contact Headland at ukwind@headlandconsultancy.com.
The sessions will also be webcast and the presentations made available via the website https://www.greencoat-ukwind.com/.
